lines.en: label library25:
scene black
I decide to spend the morning at the library.
lines.zh: 我决定这个上午就在图书馆过。

lines.en: Futaba and I haven't done anything exciting together lately, so I’m thinking it might be time to amp things up a bit.
lines.zh: Futaba 和我最近没一起做过什么让人兴奋的事，所以我在想，也许是时候加点料了。

lines.en: Or at least as much as a person like me {i}can{/i} ‘amp things up.’
lines.zh: 或者至少，在我这种人{i}能{/i}做到的范围内加一加。

lines.en: It’s clear that she’s fond of me. That much I’ve known since the beginning.
lines.zh: 她显然喜欢我。这一点我从一开始就知道了。

lines.en: But if you told me months ago that I’d somehow start developing ‘feelings’ for her, I’d have called you insane.
lines.zh: 但要是几个月前你告诉我，我竟会对她产生「感情」，我肯定会说你疯了。

lines.en: I’m not meant to become attached to anyone.
lines.zh: 我本不该对任何人产生依恋。

lines.en: That’s not why I’m here.
lines.zh: 我来这儿不是为了这个。

lines.en: But there’s something about receiving constant, undeserved affection from someone that sort of flips a switch inside of your head.
lines.zh: 可是，持续不断地接受某个人那份你根本配不上的爱意，会在你脑子里拨动某个开关。

lines.en: It makes you think you actually {i}do{/i} deserve it.
lines.zh: 它会让你觉得自己{i}其实{/i}是配得上的。

lines.en: I wonder if that’s what’s happening to me?
lines.zh: 我在想，我现在是不是就是这样？

lines.en: That must be what's happening to me.
lines.zh: 一定就是这样。

lines.en: scene morningmoon1
Sunlight permeates the air of the library, illuminating scattered dust particles trying to sneak their way into my eyes.
lines.zh: 阳光渗透进图书馆的空气里，照亮了四处飘散、想方设法要钻进我眼睛的尘埃。

lines.en: Amidst my partially-obscured vision stands Futaba Fukuyama, volunteer librarian and full-time student, engrossed in a book I can’t make out from here.
lines.zh: 在我有些模糊的视线中，站着 Futaba Fukuyama——志愿图书管理员兼全日制学生——正埋头读着一本我从这里看不清名字的书。

lines.en: I imagine it’s a happy one.
lines.zh: 我想那应该是个快乐的故事。

lines.en: Maybe something with dragons or princesses.
lines.zh: 也许是讲龙或者公主之类的。

lines.en: Something to help distract her from how horrible life really is and how, on average, we consume over fifty pounds of these same dust particles every year.
lines.zh: 好让她不去想生活到底有多糟糕，也不去想我们平均每年都会吞下超过五十磅这样的尘埃。

lines.en: She might not be thinking about that last part, but I am.
lines.zh: 最后那一点她大概没在想，但我在想。

lines.en: Anyway, life isn't horrible for her and her alone. It's like that for all of us.
lines.zh: 话说回来，生活糟糕的可不只是她一个人。我们所有人都是这样。

lines.en: And no one who is truly happy with their life spends this much time reading.
lines.zh: 而且，真正对自己生活满意的人，是不会花这么多时间看书的。

lines.en: Reading is an escape mechanism. And if you love where you are, or {i}who{/i} you are-
lines.zh: 阅读是一种逃避机制。如果你热爱自己所处的境地，或者热爱{i}自己{/i}这个人——

lines.en: Well...what is there to escape from?
lines.zh: 那么……又有什么好逃避的？

lines.en: I imagine you want me to shut up right about now, correct?
lines.zh: 我猜你现在很想让我闭嘴，对吧？

lines.en: Well, I’m sorry, but I won’t.
lines.zh: 嗯，抱歉，我不会闭嘴。

lines.en: I am here to remind you of how horrible all of this is.
lines.zh: 我来这里，是为了提醒你这一切有多糟糕。

lines.en: Let my words be a floor of daggers, cutting into your feet with every step you take.
lines.zh: 让我的话化作一地匕首，你每走一步，都割进你的脚底。

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: Oh, Sensei! I didn’t see you walk in.
lines.zh: : 啊，老师！我没看到你走进来。

lines.en: : How are you this morning?
lines.zh: : 今天早上好吗？

lines.en: : I’m pretty good. What are you reading?
lines.zh: : 挺好的。你在读什么？

lines.en: : Huh? Oh, just some book about...umm...
lines.zh: : 啊？哦，就是一本关于……呃……的书……

lines.en: scene morningmoon3
: Umm...
She looks away in an attempt to escape from her escape mechanism.
lines.zh: 她把视线移开，试图从她的逃避机制中逃出来。

lines.en: : I guess it's about...dragons...and stuff...hahah...
lines.zh: : 大概是关于……龙……之类的……哈哈哈……

lines.en: Princesses too, I imagine.
lines.zh: 我猜公主也少不了。

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: Things have been pretty slow around here lately, so I was reorganizing the fantasy section.
lines.zh: : 最近这里一直挺清闲的，所以我在重新整理奇幻区。

lines.en: : But...then I came across a book I used to read when I was little and...
lines.zh: : 不过……后来我翻到了一本小时候读过的书，然后……

lines.en: scene morningmoon3
: Well, one thing kind of led to another...
lines.zh: : 嗯，然后就一件接一件地……

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: Did you read a lot when you were younger, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师，你小时候读很多书吗？

lines.en: : Me?
: Uhh...I-
: Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: : Sorry. I just feel like there's something I want to say here, but I can't quite put my finger on it...
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我只是觉得这里有什么话想说，可怎么也抓不住……

lines.en: : You...um...
scene morningmoon3
: I'm...also having a hard time finding the words I want to say, but...I imagine someone as talented as you read quite a lot when you were a child.
lines.zh: : 我……也一时找不到想说的话，不过……我想像你这么有才华的人，小时候一定读过不少书。

lines.en: : Maybe I did. Maybe I didn't. There's no way to know for sure.
lines.zh: : 也许读过。也许没有。没办法确定。

lines.en: : No, I suppose there isn't...
lines.zh: : 是啊，我想是没办法……

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: But I don't think it was luck alone that got you here, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 但我不觉得你走到今天靠的只是运气，老师。

lines.en: : And I think that...it isn't entirely a bad thing to just...{i}make up{/i} memories if you can't find ones you enjoy on your own.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得……如果自己找不到喜欢的记忆，就干脆{i}编{/i}一些出来，也不完全是坏事。

lines.en: : That's a...relatively uncharacteristic thing for you to say, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 这……可不太像你会说的话啊，Futaba。

lines.en: scene morningmoon4
: Is it? How so?
lines.zh: : 是吗？怎么说？

lines.en: : You've just always struck me as the more...honest type.
lines.zh: : 你一向给我一种……比较诚实的印象。

lines.en: : I don't think what I suggested was dishonest. I see it as...just one more form of creativity?
lines.zh: : 我不觉得我说的那种做法不诚实。我把它看作……又一种形式的创造力？

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: Like...writing a book! Just the book is {i}you.{/i} And it's highly probable that you just...filled in the pages out of order and have to...go back and make some corrections?
lines.zh: : 就像……写一本书！只不过那本书就是{i}你自己{/i}。而且很可能你只是……把页码填乱了顺序，需要……回头做一些修正？

lines.en: : Nice try. But I'm sure that whatever I have to say about my reading habits as a child isn't anywhere near that...dramatic or serious.
lines.zh: : 说得好。不过我敢肯定，关于我小时候的阅读习惯，我要说的可没那么……戏剧化，也没那么严肃。

lines.en: : I'm pretty positive I was just a normal person who did normal shit and is now going to work a normal job until he dies.
lines.zh: : 我非常确定，我只是个做着普通事的普通人，接下来会干一份普通的工作，直到死掉。

lines.en: : I think you're amazing, Sensei. I-
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很了不起，老师。我——

lines.en: : I didn't come here to talk about myself, Futaba. Tell me about what you want to do instead.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿不是为了谈我自己，Futaba。跟我说说你想做什么吧。

lines.en: scene morningmoon5
: Oh...I'm...Okay, sure!
lines.zh: : 哦……我……好的，当然！

lines.en: : I still don’t...really know what I want to do when I'm done with school...
lines.zh: : 我还是不太……清楚毕业以后想做什么……

lines.en: : But it's probably a safe bet to assume it’ll be something involving books.
lines.zh: : 不过八成是跟书有关的事情。

lines.en: scene morningmoon3
: Maybe I can get a job at a publishing company or...open a book store?
lines.zh: : 也许我可以去出版社工作，或者……开一家书店？

lines.en: : Would you come visit me if I owned a book store, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 要是我开了书店，你会来看我吗，老师？

lines.en: : Of course. I already come visit you at the library all the time.
lines.zh: : 当然。反正我已经老是来图书馆找你了。

lines.en: : Might be nice to get a discount on stuff too. Maybe I'd actually pick up a book for the first time in...well, as long as I can remember.
lines.zh: : 能打折也不错。说不定我真会拿起一本书来看——在我记忆里这还是头一回。

lines.en: : Everything here is free...isn’t that the biggest discount there is?
lines.zh: : 这里的东西本来就全是免费的……那不就是最大的折扣吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but I need to give everything back and that's no fun.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我还得把东西都还回去，那就没意思了。

lines.en: scene morningmoon6
: Well...you never take anything out in the first place, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……你本来也从没借走过什么，所以……

lines.en: : That’s just because I’m kind enough to leave the books for people who need them more than me.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为我人好，把书留给比我更需要的人。

lines.en: : How awfully considerate of you...
lines.zh: : 您可真是体贴入微啊……

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: But, I guess I understand. Book stores are much more fun than libraries.
lines.zh: : 不过，我想我能理解。书店确实比图书馆有意思多了。

lines.en: : It’s nice owning the things you care about.
lines.zh: : 能把自己喜欢的东西据为己有，感觉很好。

lines.en: : The value of something that’s already been used by someone else is always a little worse, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 被别人用过的东西，价值总会稍微低一点，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...something like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……差不多吧。

lines.en: scene morningmoon7
: Th...That being said...
lines.zh: : 话、话虽如此……

lines.en: : I'm glad you showed up today, because...
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你今天来了，因为……

lines.en: : Well, there’s actually something I’ve been meaning to ask you for a little while now, but I’m kind of nervous so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，其实有件事我想问你已经有一阵子了，但我有点紧张，所以……

lines.en: : I’m not really sure if {i}right now{/i} is the best time or...if I'll even be able to follow through with it...
lines.zh: : 我不太确定{i}现在{/i}是不是最好的时机，或者……我到底能不能问出口……

lines.en: : Is this a confession?
lines.zh: : 这是告白吗？

lines.en: scene morningmoon8
: Keh-!
Looks like I might have hit the nail on the head.
lines.zh: 看来我可能一击就戳中了要害。

lines.en: scene morningmoon9
: That's...That’s not it! That comes later!
lines.zh: : 不、不是的！那是之后的事！

lines.en: : So...it {i}is{/i} coming then?
lines.zh: : 所以……之后{i}会{/i}有？

lines.en: : I...never said that!
lines.zh: : 我……可没说过！

lines.en: : It was {i}very{/i} heavily implied. Besides, do you really think I don’t know by now?
lines.zh: : 这暗示得已经{i}很{/i}明显了。再说了，你真觉得我到现在还看不出来？

lines.en: : I’m not some dense harem protagonist- I’m the other kind. The kind that's suspiciously successful with girls despite putting in virtually no effort whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 我可不是那种迟钝的后宫男主——我是另一种。那种几乎不费吹灰之力，却在女生身上成功得可疑的类型。

lines.en: : That sort of character is entirely unrealistic, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那种角色完全不现实啊，老师。

lines.en: : Exactly. Nothing is real, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 正是。没有什么是真实的，Futaba。

lines.en: : Nothing is...real?
lines.zh: : 没有什么是……真实的？

lines.en: : Not you, not me...
lines.zh: : 你不是，我不是……

lines.en: : Nothing.
lines.zh: : 什么都不真实。

lines.en: scene morningmoon4
: That's...an interesting philosophy.
lines.zh: : 这……倒是个有意思的哲学。

lines.en: : I'm sure there's more to it, but I didn't really have any idea where I was going with it.
lines.zh: : 我敢说这背后还有更多东西，不过我自己也不知道要往哪儿说。

lines.en: : Just in a weird mood today, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概今天心情有点怪吧。

lines.en: scene morningmoon5
: Well, I'm glad your weird mood landed you here...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴你带着这种怪心情来了这里……

lines.en: : Because what I've been meaning to ask you involves...umm...a yes or a no...And I'd like to know soon so I can stop agonizing over your answer.
lines.zh: : 因为我想问你的这件事，需要……呃……一个「是」或者「不是」……而且我想早点知道答案，好不用再为你的回复备受煎熬。

lines.en: : But...it's {i}not{/i} a confession?
lines.zh: : 不过……{i}不是{/i}告白？

lines.en: : It's not a confession.
lines.zh: : 不是告白。

lines.en: : Because that made it sound a lot like a confession.
lines.zh: : 因为刚才那段听起来可太像告白了。

lines.en: scene morningmoon9
: Stop calling it that! My heart can't take it!
lines.zh: : 别再那么叫了！我的心脏受不了！

lines.en: scene morningmoon3
: I’d understand if you don’t want to do it since I’m kind of...you know...a {i}little{/i} bit younger than someone you’d want to spend time with outside of school.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想答应，我也理解，因为我……你知道的……比你在校外愿意相处的人要小上{i}一点{/i}。

lines.en: : I think I’ve made it overwhelmingly clear that our age gap makes zero difference to me.
lines.zh: : 我想我已经说得再清楚不过了，我们的年龄差对我毫无影响。

lines.en: : This is a little...different, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这次有点……不一样。

lines.en: : Almost everything we've done has been here...or the dorms...We've barely been to any places where we'd seem...{i}out of{/i} place.
lines.zh: : 我们做过的事几乎全都在这儿……或者宿舍……我们几乎没去过任何会显得我们……{i}格格不入{/i}的地方。

lines.en: : And I'm comfortable with you everywhere, but...
lines.zh: : 而且我跟你在一起到哪里都很自在，可是……

lines.en: scene morningmoon5
: That doesn’t mean it’s not a little nerve-wracking when I think about going somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 这不代表一想到要去别的地方，我就不会有点紧张。

lines.en: : I li-...I really respect you as a person and a teacher and I’m worried that you’ll maybe...
lines.zh: : 我喜……我很敬重你这个人，也敬重你这位老师，我担心你也许会……

lines.en: scene morningmoon3
: I don’t know...get bored of me or something?...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……会对我感到厌倦之类的？……

lines.en: : It’s hard to explain.
lines.zh: : 这很难解释清楚。

lines.en: : Then don’t explain it. Just ask whatever you want to ask me and we’ll take it from there.
lines.zh: : 那就别解释了。你想问什么就问，我们到时候再见招拆招。

lines.en: : It’s probably just about accompanying you to a new book store or something along those lines, right?
lines.zh: : 大概就是陪你去一家新开的书店之类的，对吧？

lines.en: scene morningmoon8
: Keh-!
Second nail hit. This fence will be built in no time at all.
lines.zh: 第二根钉子也敲中了。这道篱笆眼看就要搭好了。

lines.en: : H-H-How did you-
lines.zh: : 你、你、你怎么——

lines.en: : It's the next logical step, isn't it? Something with the potential to pull the two of us closer together.
lines.zh: : 这是顺理成章的下一步，不是吗？一件有可能让我们俩靠得更近的事。

lines.en: : If we don't start doing things like that, everything will just...stagnate.
lines.zh: : 如果我们不开始做这类事，一切就只会……停滞不前。

lines.en: scene morningmoon4
: Stagnate? How so?
lines.zh: : 停滞？怎么说？

lines.en: : You know that fake Einstein quote about how doing the same thing over and over again is the definition of insanity? Well, that applies to relationships too.
lines.zh: : 你知道那句假的 Einstein 名言吧——反复做同一件事就是疯狂的定义？嗯，那也适用于恋爱关系。

lines.en: : We can't just confine our time together to school or the dorm. Fake Einstein would hate that.
lines.zh: : 我们不能把相处的时间只局限在学校或宿舍。假的 Einstein 会讨厌那样。

lines.en: : So, if going out there and doing new things together is how we're supposed to keep this alive, sure. I see no problem with that.
lines.zh: : 所以，如果一起出去做些新鲜事是维持这段关系的办法，那当然。我觉得没什么问题。

lines.en: : Is that really what you think?
lines.zh: : 你真的是这么想的吗？

lines.en: scene morningmoon7
: Is {i}what{/i} really what I think? I said a lot just now.
lines.zh: : 我真的{i}怎么{/i}想？我刚才说了一大堆呢。

lines.en: : That we'll...fizzle out if we don't open up a little more.
lines.zh: : 是说如果我们不稍微放开一点，就会……慢慢淡掉。

lines.en: : Because all this time, I was worried that the exact opposite would be the biggest issue for you.
lines.zh: : 因为一直以来，我担心的恰恰相反——那才是你最大的问题。

lines.en: : The world is big, even if the majority of it is closed off to us.
lines.zh: : 世界很大，尽管其中大部分都对我们关上了门。

lines.en: : But that doesn't mean we should trap ourselves in an even smaller box because we're afraid of what might be outside.
lines.zh: : 但这不代表我们应该因为害怕外面的东西，就把自己关进一个更小的盒子里。
: 所以……

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: Wait, does that mean you’ll come?
lines.zh: : 等等，那意思是你会来？

lines.en: : Of course. It would be pure evil if I were to build this up like that and then say no.
lines.zh: : 当然。要是我铺垫了这么多然后说不去，那简直是坏透了。

lines.en: scene morningmoon10
: Hahaha! It really would!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！确实会！

lines.en: : But I never really know with you and...and...
lines.zh: : 可我永远猜不透你在想什么，而且……而且……

lines.en: scene morningmoon10r
: You...have no idea how excited this makes me, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 你……根本不知道这让我有多兴奋，老师……

lines.en: : I didn’t think...you’d ever want to go on a date with someone like me...
lines.zh: : 我没想到……你居然会想和像我这样的人约会……

lines.en: To be fair, I never said it was a {i}date{/i}...But I guess that was heavily implied as well.
lines.zh: 说句公道话，我从没说过这是{i}约会{/i}……不过我想这也暗示得很明显了。

lines.en: And it's not like I mind. Futaba can probably pass as a college student if the two of us go out together anyway.
lines.zh: 而且我也不介意。反正要是我们俩一起出去，Futaba 大概也能冒充个大学生。

lines.en: Plus, if it can get her to smile like that, she can ask me on as many {i}dates{/i} as she wants.
lines.zh: 再说了，只要能让她那样笑，她想{i}约我{/i}多少次都行。

lines.en: : I guess you were wrong, then. But let me ask you this...why aren't {i}you{/i} weirded out by the idea of being seen with me?
lines.zh: : 那看来你想错了。不过我倒要问你……为什么{i}你{/i}一点也不介意被别人看到跟我在一起？

lines.en: : If people {i}do{/i} see us together, they might assume all types of things.
lines.zh: : 要是{i}真{/i}有人看到我们在一起，他们可能会往各种方向上联想。

lines.en: scene morningmoon10r2
: And...they would probably be right about half of them.
lines.zh: : 而且……他们大概有一半会猜对。

lines.en: : Fair point.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: Besides, I love the idea of being seen with someone like you!
lines.zh: : 再说，我倒是很喜欢被别人看到和你这样的人在一起！

lines.en: : I feel like any time I go anywhere, it's with either Rin or one of my friends from my old school...and you're so much...well...{i}cooler{/i} than them.
lines.zh: : 感觉不管我去哪儿，身边不是 Rin 就是我以前学校的某个朋友……而你比她们……嗯……{i}酷多了{/i}。

lines.en: : Don't let Rin hear that. She'll probably cry.
lines.zh: : 可别让 Rin 听到。她大概会哭的。

lines.en: scene morningmoon10
: Heheh...probably...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……大概是吧……

lines.en: : Can I ask you one more question before I head out, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 在我走之前，能再问你一个问题吗，Futaba？

lines.en: scene morningmoon2
: Of course, Sensei! Ask anything you-
lines.zh: : 当然，老师！问什么都——

lines.en: : Are you absolutely positive you're not asking me out because you’re actually in love with me? Because now would be a good time to just admit it already.
lines.zh: : 你真的确定，你约我不是因为你其实爱上我了吗？现在可是坦白的好时机。

lines.en: scene morningmoon8
: Keh-!
Third nail. Fence complete.
lines.zh: 第三根钉子。篱笆搭好了。

lines.en: scene black
"Futaba and I make plans to meet at her dorm room sometime over the
lines.zh: "我和 Futaba 约好周末找个时间在她的宿舍房间碰面，她跟我说明了那家店的

lines.en: weekend and she goes over where the store is located."
lines.zh: 位置。"

lines.en: "Apparently, it’s not all that far from here and is open relatively late, so we should be
lines.zh: "听说那里离这儿不算太远，而且营业到挺晚，所以我们应该能

lines.en: able to head over at night."
lines.zh: 晚上过去。"

lines.en: It’s strange going on a nighttime ‘date’ to a book store, but I guess it is what it is.
lines.zh: 大晚上去书店「约会」是挺奇怪的，不过我想也就这样吧。

lines.en: I’m just glad that I’ll be getting to spend more time with her.
lines.zh: 我只是很高兴能有更多时间和她待在一起。

lines.en: And that, for some strange reason...she continues to give me things I do not deserve.
lines.zh: 而且，出于某种奇怪的理由……她还在不断给我那些我配不上的东西。
